Team,

Quick heads-up: we have Eli Turner (SWE L3) scheduled for an on-site loop next Tuesday (May 11). Two panelists just flagged last-minute conflicts — one is traveling, the other had an emergency calendar clash. I want to avoid cancelling; candidate is mid-process and recruiting has confirmed limited availability windows.

Proposed plan:
- Swap the system-design slot to a later interviewer (Mina?) and move the backend/infra slot to Vivek.
- Add a "shadow" interviewer for behavioral and cultural fit so we have a backup for any no-shows.
- Send a consolidated calendar update and candidate prep to Eli.

Can the two of you confirm availability for swaps below? If we can't fill, we'll escalate to CS for overflow but prefer to keep hiring team engaged.

Candidate details and short packet attached (candidate-pack_Eli-Turner.pdf). I also added the provisional calendar invite (calendar-loop-invite.ics).

Thanks,
